verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a public REST API for CI systems, internal platforms and agent workflows. The docs cover authentication with scoped roles such as role_org_viewer and concrete versioned endpoints like POST /v1/connectors/{id}/deletion-lock and quarantine release. A scriptable CLI with stable JSON output, JSON errors and token-based non-interactive auth adds to this. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), branch-lifecycle API endpoints not directly evidenced in the pack, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
